name: Laser-Induced Plasma and Bubble Volumetric Displays
definition: A system where a specific 3D volume element in a voxel grid represents the emission of light from a self-emitting point light source.
summary: Laser-induced plasma and bubble volumetric displays create self-emitting 3D voxels in free space or liquid using focused laser pulses, distinguishing themselves by rendering without physical screens or moving macroscopic parts.
